heroSubhead: Hi, I'm Ray Maina. Full-stack engineer & native Android developer building high-performance web platforms (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) and AI-powered mobile experiences (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose).

about.paragraph1: I'm a full-stack engineer and native Android specialist. I bridge scalable backend infrastructure with fluid web applications and native Android apps integrated with Generative AI.
about.paragraph2: My web stack centers on React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL/Supabase. On mobile, I build native Android applications using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and modern Clean Architecture.

projects.title: DeskFlow — Enterprise IT Help Desk
projects.tagline: An IT help desk application designed to help organisations manage internal IT support requests, track ticket progress, and coordinate support work across different user roles.
projects.overview: DeskFlow provides a central interface for submitting support tickets, managing their status, recording communication, and reviewing support activity.
projects.challenge: Without a central tracking system, Organisations IT requests can be difficult to prioritise, assign, and monitor.
architecture: React frontend with strict TypeScript and optimistic UI state updates.
Modular Express.js backend with superbase auth and Row-Level Security (RLS).
Supabase PostgreSQL with pgvector for sub-millisecond semantic search.
